messages.subject: Davis R Users' Group - Winter 2023 Edition
parts:
Hello D-RUG'rs!

The Davis R Users' Group will be meeting every Thursday from 10am-noon in the Datalab classroom (Room 360 in Shields Library). And if you can't make it in person, you can always join via zoom! 

Meetings will be in typical D-RUG fashion - we will start with a short presentation about something R-related and then open it up to work group time where you can ask/answer questions or just work alongside other R users. With that said, we are looking for presenters! Usually, these presentations last between 15 to 45 minutes and can be anything from discussing an interesting papeR to working with different data types in R to writing a package. If you are interested in presenting (in person or remotely), please respond to this email and we'll add you to the D-RUG calendar for the quarter. 

Best,
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
